bugs.title: Social queue can skip approval guardrails
bugs.summary: On v1.2.1, POST /api/queue stored status approved or retry without guardrails. On v1.2.3-test that POST is stored as pending_approval.
bugs.expected: A client cannot store an approved or retry queue row that the publisher will send.
bugs.actual: v1.2.3-test POST with status approved or retry is stored as pending_approval.

history.note: v1.2.1 audit: POST stored approved or retry and skipped guardrails.
f2440e1 test flavor stores POST approved or retry as pending_approval.
v1.2.3-test recheck: POST still forces pending_approval. Owner approval is not set.

bugs.title: Queue row can be marked published with no external post
bugs.summary: v1.2.1 accepted PUT status published with a null externalId. The prod flavor of f2440e1 still stored a client externalId. 7327a1e and v1.2.3-test return HTTP 403.
bugs.expected: HTTP cannot mark a row published, and a client externalId is not stored as a platform post.
bugs.actual: v1.2.3-test PUT of status published plus externalId is HTTP 403. The prod flavor of f2440e1 stored the client id.
repro: PUT /api/queue/:id with status published and an externalId
Read the HTTP status and the stored row

history.note: v1.2.1 PUT status published returned 200 with externalId still null.
f2440e1 prod flavor stored a client externalId as published. Test flavor returned 403.
v1.2.3-test HTTP 403 stands. Owner approval is not set.

bugs.title: Upgrade does not snapshot the database
bugs.summary: v1.2.1 altered the database on startup with no copy. Later builds write a pre-migration VACUUM INTO backup and a sha256 sidecar.
bugs.expected: Opening a v1-shaped database writes a restorable snapshot before migration.
bugs.actual: v1.2.3-test wrote pre-migration-v1-to-v4-*.db and a matching .sha256. The seeded task survived.
repro: Place a v1-shaped studio.db with tables items and meta
Compare the pre-migration backup to its sha256 sidecar

history.note: v1.2.1 startup ALTER had no snapshot. Rollback was a copy made beforehand.
v1.2.3-test pre-migration backup plus sha256 sidecar matched. Owner approval is not set.

bugs.title: OpenCode seatbelt allows writes under /private/tmp
bugs.summary: v1.2.1 allowed file-write under /private/tmp. Later source removes that allow. Runtime sandbox-exec was not run.
bugs.expected: A task write outside the sandbox directory is denied by sandbox-exec.
bugs.actual: Source no longer allows /private/tmp. sandbox-exec was not executed on this host.

history.note: Seatbelt profile allows /private/tmp and /private/var/folders. Not executed.
Source change is present. Runtime stays unverified until sandbox-exec runs on a Mac.

bugs.title: BUILD-INFO names fuse index 8 undefined
bugs.summary: The v1.2.1 packager printed fuse index 8 as undefined. The v1.2.3-test BUILD-INFO names that byte WasmTrapHandlers Enabled.
bugs.expected: BUILD-INFO names fuse index 8 instead of printing undefined.
bugs.actual: v1.2.3-test BUILD-INFO prints WasmTrapHandlers enabled via @electron/fuses 2.1.3.

history.note: Fuse byte was ENABLE. The packager enum had no name, so the text said undefined is Enabled.
v1.2.3-test BUILD-INFO names WasmTrapHandlers. Owner approval is not set.

bugs.title: Comment POST stores status approved
bugs.summary: v1.2.3-test generic POST /api/comments stores status approved. The test /reply route returns HTTP 403 and does not send.
bugs.expected: A client POST cannot store a comment as approved when reply is disabled.
bugs.actual: POST stores approved. POST /api/comments/:id/reply is HTTP 403 publishing_disabled.

history.note: Left for v1.2.4 by the product doc. Reply does not send. Owner approval is not set.

bugs.title: Live SQL published row stays published until restart
bugs.summary: A row inserted with SQL into the live studio.db stays published on GET until the next start. HTTP PUT of that row is 403.
bugs.expected: A published row that fails the seal is not served as published.
bugs.actual: GET stays published until restart. PUT is HTTP 403 published_internal_only. The next start demotes the row and keeps historical fields.
repro: Insert a queue row with SQL status published and an externalId
GET the row before and after a restart
PUT a title change and expect HTTP 403

history.note: demoteUnsealed runs at startup. HTTP cannot create the row. Owner approval is not set.

bugs.title: Local flavor rewrite plus planted meta.js loads the publisher
bugs.summary: Rewriting every flavor marker so they agree, planting meta.js, and starting node server.js loads the publisher. The Electron flavor guard still exits 78.
bugs.expected: A local rewrite of the unpacked tree cannot load the publisher.
bugs.actual: node server.js on the rewritten tree reports flavor prod. desktop/flavor-guard.js still fails closed for the Electron app.
repro: Rewrite lib/flavor.baked.js, lib/flavor.lock.json, and package.json studioFlavor hashes so they agree on prod
Run desktop/flavor-guard.js against the original asar lock

history.note: Requires a local write and skipping Electron. Full close is blocked on Developer ID and notarization.
